thread:
harper: Quick sync  emergency signing fallback drill Monday 09:00 PT. Scenario: primary cosign key rotation hits a KMS outage/compromise; we need an approved fallback key (HSM-stored) and clear RBAC+audit mapping before promoting new images. Need buy-in from infra + oncall.

diego: +1. Are we doing a live drill or table-top? I prefer a live canary against a small staging fleet so we validate telemetry.

sylvie: Live canary is fine as long as we have rollback artifacts. Also: this is a good time to validate cross-region publicKeyViewer bindings so verifiers in other projects can still validate signatures.

kms-ops-bot: CI note: ensure attestor emits `key_fingerprint` and `attestation_chain` fields in audit events. Example assertion: `audit.events[*].key_fingerprint != null`.

harper: Proposed checklist: 1) provision fallback key in KMS-HSM (strategy doc linked), 2) grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner` to `serviceAccount:runtime-fallback-signer@...` with a short-lived condition, 3) grant `roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer` to `serviceAccount:ops-verifier@...` in verification projects, 4) validate SBOM+sig ingestion in telemetry, 5) run canary (2% staging), validate, then promote.

diego: IAM diff (GCP-style minimal):
``` 
+ resource "google_kms_key_ring" "fallback" { ... }
+ resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "fallback_key" { protection_level = "HSM" }
+ google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding.fallback_signer {
    role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"
    members = ["serviceAccount:runtime-fallback-signer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
  }
+ google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding.fallback_pubviewer {
    role = "roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer"
    members = ["serviceAccount:ops-verifier@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
  }
```

sylvie: Also add an IAM condition so Sign is allowed only when `resource.name` matches the fallback key and only from the CI principal. Example condition snippet in MR.

kms-ops-bot: Security reminder: keep old primary key publicKeyViewer for 72h read-only to help cross-verification. Also log keyVersion and key_fingerprint in the audit event.

harper: Ops/telemetry asked for a sample audit event shape including new fields. Draft below (compact):
```
{
  "image_sha": "sha256:0a1b2c3d4e",
  "sbom_uri": "gs://sboms/sha256-0a1b2c3d.json",
  "signature_ref": "projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/fallback/cryptoKeys/cosign/signatures/abcd",
  "key_version": "5",
  "key_fingerprint": "SHA256:ZzYxW...",
  "attestation_chain": ["predicate.json","attest.sig"],
  "signature_algorithm": "RSA-PSS-2048",
  "deployed_by": "serviceAccount:ci-deployer",
  "region": "us-west1",
  "timestamp": "2026-04-20T16:00:00Z"
}
```

diego: Nice. Telemetry needs `key_fingerprint` as a string and `attestation_chain` as a list of URIs; they'll accept the above after a minor schema bump.

sylvie: Triage note: we should also run a vuln scan post-sign using the fallback signer and assert identical SBOM+sig pairing. If SBOM mismatch -> block promotion.

infra-oncall: Rollback playbook for the drill (if verification fails or canary error rate >2%):
```
# revert registry tag to previous sha
gsutil cp gs://registry/tags/staging:prev-sha gs://registry/current-tag
# redeploy previous digest (explicit)
kubectl set image deployment/runtime-staging runtime=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:prev-sha -n staging || kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-staging -n staging
# reattach old attestation if needed
cosign attach --predicate old-predicate.json --signature old.sig gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:prev-sha
```
Also page #incident if `signature.verify.fail` alert fires.

harper: Action items: 1) @diego open infra MR for fallback key + IAM bindings with condition, 2) @sylvie run a test sign/verify cycle and post SBOM+sig diff, 3) @infra-oncall add rollback snippet to runbook and be on watch, 4) @harper bump telemetry schema and post the sample event to ops. Target drill Monday 09:00 PT, canary = 2% staging for 15m.

diego: MR created: https://git.internal/infra/mr/8204  contains tf changes, condition example, and acceptance tests (sign/verify). Please review.

kms-ops-bot: CI checklist: `sbom-verify` must pass and `auditlog.write` must be emitted. Tests will fail the pipeline otherwise.

sylvie: Quick vuln triage: candidate image had an allowlist drift for `libxml2` (minor bump). No NVD CVEs found. Marking non-blocker but will attach SBOM diff.

harper: If all approvals go green I'll merge MR and we run the scheduled drill. If verification fails we follow rollback and open an incident.

infra-oncall: I'll be on watch during the window and will escalate as needed.

harper: thanks team. Will post runbook link when MR merges.
